contact.title: Contact Doccys
contact.intro: Questions, bugs or need help? We read everything that lands in our inbox.

s1.title: Email us
s1.body: You can always reach us at contact@doccys.com. Please include which film and page it concerns, as well as the device or browser you are using, so we can assist you faster.

s2.title: What you can write about
s2.body:
• Technical issues on the site
• Purchase of minutes and payments
• Copyright: should a film (not) be here?
• Your personal data, e.g., deletion of your account
• Collaboration with Doccys as a creator

s3.title: Response time
s3.body: We aim to reply within two business days. Around holidays and launches it may take a little longer.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of Doccys and to the purchase of minutes. Last updated: 13 November 2026.

s1.title: About Doccys
s1.body: Doccys is a streaming service for independent documentaries: you only pay for what you actually watch, minute by minute. The service is operated by Doccys, CVR no. 46804147.

s2.title: Creating an account
s2.body: It is free to create an account. When creating an account, you must provide a valid email address and confirm it via the link in the email you receive. Only then can the account be used. You are responsible for keeping your login information confidential and for all activity that occurs through your account.

s3.title: Minutes and playback
s3.body:
Films are played against minutes on your account. Consumption is measured by the time you actually play. If you stop in the middle of a film, you only pay for the time watched. The minute price for a film is displayed on the film's page before you start playback.
Your playback is recorded as measured consumption (“proof”). Also, see the privacy policy. The proof is crucial if there is any doubt about what you have watched and what has been deducted from your balance.

s4.title: Purchases and payment
s4.body:
Minutes are purchased in packages at the prices displayed at the time of purchase. Payment is handled by our payment partner Stripe, and the receipt is sent to your email. The stated price includes VAT: VAT is calculated by Stripe Tax based on your billing country and deducted from the amount (VAT appears as a separate line on the payment page).
All amounts are in US dollars (USD). See section 13.

s5.title: Validity of minutes
s5.body: Minutes do not expire and can be used as long as your account exists. They are personal and cannot be transferred to others or exchanged for money. Minutes earned as referral bonuses follow the same rules.

s6.title: Withdrawal and errors
s6.body:
Minutes are digital content. Once playback has started, the right of withdrawal ceases according to the rules of the Purchase Agreement Act for digital content. If you have not started playback, you can write to contact@doccys.com within 14 days of purchase and receive a full refund.
If you were charged for something you could not watch due to a technical error, or if the payment went through twice, please contact us, and we will correct it.

s7.title: Creators' rights
s7.body: Part of the minute consumption goes to the film's creator. You may not download, record or share films or parts of films from Doccys. If you believe a film on Doccys infringes your rights, write to contact@doccys.com.

s8.title: Liability and content
s8.body:
Doccys is not the publisher or distributor of the films. The content and opinions in the films are those of the creators. The service is provided “as is.” We are not liable for indirect losses or lost profits, including downtime, but we will of course correct errors as quickly as we can.
We may change upcoming prices with reasonable notice; changes will never affect already purchased minutes.

s9.title: Changes to these terms
s9.body: We may update these terms. The current version is always on this page, and we announce significant changes on the site. If you keep using Doccys after a change, you accept the new version.

s10.title: Complaints and contact
s10.body: You can always write to contact@doccys.com. Danish consumers can also contact the Consumer Complaints Board for purchase complaints. See forbrugerklagenaevnet.dk. Danish law applies to these terms.

s11.title: License upon Uploading Films (Creators)
s11.body:
When you upload a film to Doccys, you confirm the following:
• You own all rights to the film, including music and archival material, and the film does not infringe on third-party rights.
• You grant Doccys a non-exclusive, worldwide, and unlimited license to stream the film on the platform, create subtitles and trailers based on the film, and market the film on the platform.
• You can request the editorial team to remove your film at any time. Write to contact@doccys.com.
• Your acceptance is recorded with a timestamp and version number with each upload and applies to the film you upload.
In case of discrepancies between translations, the Danish text is valid (cf. section 10).

s12.title: Age limit of 18 years
s12.body:
Doccys is a streaming service for adults. To create an account and use the platform, you must be at least 18 years old.
When creating the account, you confirm by checking that you are at least 18 years old. The confirmation is recorded with a timestamp and version number along with your account.
An account must not be made available to individuals under 18 years old. The content on Doccys is not selected or age-rated for children and young people.
If we become aware that a user is under 18 years old, we may close the account with immediate effect (cf. section 2 regarding your account responsibility).

s13.title: Currency
s13.body:
All amounts on Doccys are stated and charged in US dollars (USD). When the payment page and these terms show an amount with “$”, it means US dollars (USD), not another currency with a dollar sign (for example, Mexican pesos (MXN), Canadian dollars (CAD), or Argentine pesos (ARS)).
With a card denominated in another currency, the conversion occurs at your card issuer or bank at their rate and any fees. This is outside of Doccys' control; the amount on the payment page is always the USD amount.
VAT is calculated by Stripe Tax based on your billing country and deducted from the stated price. The price includes VAT (see section 4).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Here you can read which personal data Doccys processes, why, and which rights you have. Last updated: 29 September 2026.

s2.title: Which data we process
s2.body:
• Account: your email address (and confirmation of it) and your password, which is stored encrypted.
• Purchases: which packages you have purchased, purchase time, and transaction ID. Payment cards are never processed by us. This is done by Stripe.
• Playback: when you start and stop, rewinds, and consumed time per film. The measured consumption (“the proof”) is what deducts minutes from your balance and settles with the creator.
• Comments: the name you sign under, your comments and likes, and moderation thereof.
• Referrals: if you come via a referral link, we store the code in a cookie for up to 30 days, so the person who referred you can be credited with your first purchase.

s3.title: Purpose and legal basis
s3.body: We process data to provide the service: to create your account, deduct minutes from your balance, and settle with creators (contractual basis), keep the service secure and prevent abuse (legitimate interest), and fulfill accounting and tax obligations (legal obligation). We never sell your data and do not use it for advertising profiling. Doccys shows no ads, ever.

s4.title: Third parties
s4.body:
We use the following data processors:
• Supabase: login and database
• Stripe: payments and receipts
• Vercel: operations and hosting
They only process data on our behalf and for the purposes mentioned above.

s5.title: Cookies
s5.body: Doccys sets only one cookie: doccys_ref, which remembers a referral link for up to 30 days. Your language choice is stored in the page address, not in a cookie. We use no third-party tracking and no advertising cookies.

s6.title: Retention
s6.body: Account and comment data are deleted when you request it. Purchase data and proofs are stored for five years, so accounting and settlement with creators can be verified. The Accounting Act requires this.

s7.title: Your rights
s7.body:
You have the right to:
• access the data we process about you
• have incorrect data corrected
• have data deleted (with the exceptions mandated by the Accounting Act)
• receive data in a readable format (data portability)
• object to the processing
Send your request to contact@doccys.com. We will respond no later than one month after.

s8.title: Complaints
s8.body: If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Data Protection Authority. See datatilsynet.dk.

s9.title: Changes
s9.body: If we update this policy, the new version appears on this page. We announce significant changes on the site.
